description: Token budget limits for Frontier skill and documentation files. ~4 chars = 1 token.

alwaysOn.rationale: Paid on every request: router files, applyTo '**' instructions and the files hosts attach from their links (maxTokens), plus the skill/agent/instruction names and descriptions hosts list (metadataMaxTokens). Reference docs belong behind plain-text paths, not links.
